stage2_gate.description: Stage 2 (fine-tuning) is conditional and requires explicit gate pass
stage2_gate.gate_logic: Stage 2 runs ONLY IF Stage 1 best Macro-F1 > Dummy AND > Metadata-Only on inner_validation
stage2_gate.statistical_test: Paired Stratified Bootstrap 95% CI on ΔMacro-F1
stage2_gate.seed_aggregation: Mean ± std across 5 seeds; Stage 2 runs only if mean Stage 1 beats both baselines AND 95% CI lower bound > 0 for both comparisons
stage2_gate.metric_conflict_resolution: If Macro-F1 and Balanced Accuracy give different conclusions, Macro-F1 is primary. Both must pass for gate pass.
stage2_gate.reporting: Stage 2 runs reported separately with clear conditional label. Not counted in Stage 1 approval.
